{{Top|leg}}
'''Security thumbpasses''' were security measures in place in the [[Verkuylian Imperial Governor's Hall]] on [[Verkuyl]]. Coded to an individual's thumbprint, they controlled access to the [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] system to ensure that individuals did not access restricted areas.<ref name="COI">{{JournalCite|13|Conflict of Interest}}</ref>
